name: vendor: a package and a scope of one word get two names (the old naming)
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "has a name no other entry can have"

name: vendor: the old naming, seen by a real run: the finding for hono says hono's list
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "gives each of two entries that share a word a rule of its own"

name: vendor: a scope is told from a package of the same name
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "is named by the entry's own key"

name: vendor: the name does not depend on the other entries
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "keeps its name when other entries come and go"

name: vendor: each rule carries its own list
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "carries its own list for the demo's pair"

name: vendor: two keys for one thing are refused
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "refuses two keys for one thing"

name: vendor: a narrower entry that allows more is refused
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "refuses a narrower entry that allows what the wider one refuses"

name: vendor: the wider entry is found whichever comes first
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "refuses a narrower entry that allows what the wider one refuses"

name: vendor: a narrower entry that only takes away is accepted
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "accepts a narrower entry that only takes packages away"

name: vendor: a name that only begins like another is not inside it
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "does not read a name that only begins like another"

name: vendor: a package and a scope of one word are not an overlap
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "accepts a package and a scope of the same word"

name: vendor: the gates stop on such a config
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "stops the gates with that message"
